title: Dimensions of Good Character
summary: Good character involves fulfilling rights of Allah and His creations.
translation: There are two aspects of good character. One aspect is how one's relationship is with Allah, and the other is how one's relationship is with Allah's servants. This is why the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) guided us in the noble hadith that a good person is one who fulfills the rights of Allah and also does not fall short in fulfilling the rights of others. Therefore, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said that the dearest person to me is one who possesses good character. Thus, when a person fulfills both aspects of good character, only then can they be testified to have excellent character. Otherwise, many times people please others and displease Allah, or they perform excessive acts of worship trying to please Allah, but neglect and harm fellow human beings, saying bad things to them or not caring for them. Such a person does not meet the standard of good character.
